title: Watching a person move is a two-month CDC thinking milestone
summary: Most babies watch you as you move by two months, the CDC says.
body: The CDC files 'watches you as you move' under cognitive milestones at two months, separate from the social line about looking at a face. Following a person who is changing place is the item. The checklist uses a 75 percent bar and, in the agency's words, is not a substitute for standardized, validated developmental screening. It is a US list.

sources.title: Milestones by 2 Months
sources.author: CDC
sources.note: Supports 'Watches you as you move' as a two-month cognitive milestone for most children (75% or more).
